profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Rubrik
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer on the Events team at Rubrik, working on event pipelines, job monitoring and notifications. I enjoy distributed systems and obsess over the customer experience.

Email: hynguyenrebels@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Hotfixed a database cleanup job issuing about 4 billion queries per hour across production by batching its probes and adding a per-cluster setting to slow or disable it, halving total query volume on the busiest deployments
• Designed and built a notification suppression engine end to end. In security design review, weighed six access control options and chose explicit object scope checked at rule creation. Customers see exactly which objects a rule filters on, and its behavior no longer changes when the creator's permissions do. This reduces confusion, product education and support escalations
• Built a generic Go star-schema DAO framework for event data (type-safe columns, filtering, sorting, cursor pagination) and moved event series onto it; after its code-generated successor went live, root-caused and fixed the deadlocks and duplicate-key failures it hit in production
• Fixed the root cause of a recurring time sink: stale ``In Progress'' replication events had to be root-caused and cancelled one at a time by an engineer with a manual script. Traced it to a one-shot, no-retry push between clusters (7 linked duplicate customer tickets in 6 weeks) and landed fixes in both the CDM (Scala) and RSC (Go) codebases, so the source cluster now pulls the outcome from the target and RSC's cleanup job no longer gets stuck behind old entries
• Challenged a cross-team proposal to split the event-service proto to speed up Bazel builds by measuring what actually changes: enum additions were the most common change, and about 92 of 96 consuming packages would still rebuild after the split. The proposing team re-measured, agreed, and changed their first step

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Created the first user-facing report to utilize a new reporting framework that streamlined the creation of additional reports using a shared data access layer. In addition, this framework added an additional table layer to reports allowing customization of columns and group bys.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Improved Quizlet’s web UI to drive subscriptions revenue and reduce payment disputes using React, TypeScript, and PHP

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Mitigated credit/debit card cybersecurity risk by reviewing and implementing the appropriate controls and requirements

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a JavaScript web application to aggregate data for bond traders reducing transaction time by 40% leading to an increase in number of transactions and revenue
• Leveraged PyAutoGUI to screen scrape Bloomberg Terminal eliminating six hours of weekly work

projects.title: Python IDE Web Application
projects.description: Created a Python Integrated Development Environment capable of editing and running code on a web browser. Utilized Express.js framework and CodeMirror API for syntax highlighting and intelligent code completion. Deployed application using AWS EC2 and NGINX for load balancing.

projects.title: Algorithms Tracer Web Application
projects.description: Allows users to trace the execution of popular/interesting algorithms (e.g. Two Pointer approach for the Two Sum problem) on entered input. Provides a step-by-step visual representation of the execution of an algorithm.
